title: Kesko invoice pilot: a fictional, one-week sample (not a verified case study)

blocks.text: Fictional employee test. This is not an actual Kesko project, meeting or outcome. Everything below is drawn from the internal project notes, which are staff-supplied and not independently verified. Do not publish, send externally or treat as a client case study without verification and written client and Velho approval.
Headline (only measured outcome, marked as a one-week sample): A one-week invoice sample showed weekly staff time falling from 12 to 8 hours after a pilot.

rows: Staff hours per week, small invoice sample (one week measured each)

blocks.text: Source: staff-supplied project notes only. Only one week was measured for the sample. No conflicting statistics were supplied.
Staff noticed that a small sample of invoice handling took about 12 hours of staff time per week before a pilot. The notes say the same sample took about 8 hours in the week measured after the pilot.

The measurement covers a single week on each side, so it is an early signal rather than a stable result. Duplicate spreadsheet entry was identified by staff as something worth exploring, but it has not been removed or proven to be the cause of the change.
No financial savings were measured, and the pilot has not been deployed in production. No buyer has agreed to a purchase.
The next step proposed is to test whether the reduction holds over a longer period and across a larger sample, before any wider claim is made.
4) Drafts (for Velho staff review only, not sent)
